title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo autonomous vehicles were stranded on San Francisco streets when their batteries drained during severe traffic congestion following Fourth of July celebrations. The vehicles were deployed in conditions of major traffic disruption and unexpected road closures that exceeded their operational capability. The system lacked either adequate battery capacity for extended gridlock or a failsafe mechanism to relocate vehicles before depletion in such scenarios.

This is a failure of system design meeting real-world conditions. Autonomous vehicle deployments operate in human-controlled traffic systems subject to unpredictable events like holiday congestion and road closures. It was not established whether Waymo had evaluated battery endurance requirements under extended gridlock or whether operators had protocols to proactively move vehicles before stranding.

One vehicle also caught fire after driving over fireworks on the road, which suggests the system either could not detect or was deployed despite hazards that lay outside design assumptions. The incident shows both a capacity problem and potentially inadequate consideration of edge cases in a dense urban environment during high-disruption events.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
Several Waymo autonomous vehicles were stranded on San Francisco streets after their batteries drained during severe traffic congestion following Fourth of July fireworks celebrations. Video footage showed at least a dozen stationary Waymo vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up on city streets, with at least one vehicle on a flatbed truck. The company attributed the gridlock to major traffic disruptions, high volumes of travelers, and unexpected road closures. One Waymo vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks that someone had set off, though no injuries were reported.

Frustrated motorists spent hours stuck in traffic while some Waymo vehicles remained stationary at intersections. Mayor Daniel Lurie's office announced plans to meet with public and private partners to address the traffic situation. Waymo stated it is evaluating ways to improve its system's ability to handle major traffic disruptions. This incident follows a December incident when Waymo briefly paused service after a citywide power outage affected traffic lights and caused some vehicles to stall at intersections.
